texts.text: A long way down. She said the idol is at the bottom. You believed her.
The mouth of it. Sand shelves rumble before they go. Stone holds.
Below the hall, the floor is gone.
Someone laid them here. Rows of them. You do not look at the faces.
Something pale is coiled in the dark. It does not move while you watch it.
Hook the pillars and swing. Stairs on the near wall, if you fall.
Three holes, low in the wall. One goes through. You will have to crawl.
You can stand. Your knees are bleeding. Ahead, green light.
The light down here grows. Three pieces of the idol were hidden in the deep. The foundry door wants all three.
Something glints in the moss.
Four kilns, cold. Light them all.
Roots of something that should not be this deep.
The ground is gone. Only the roots hold.
The roots are moving. No. Something is moving through them.
The water left. The mist stayed.
Four plates. Everyone stands on one. Alone, the door will not wait for you.
You cannot see the bottom. Good.
A whole village fell into the dark. Some of it is still falling.
Something glints on that roof.
Did the wall just breathe?
Cold light. The ice shelves tilt toward the pit. Keep moving, or hook in.
Across the chasm, a side passage glows.
The kilns still burn. The door ahead wears the mark of the idol.
No floor. Only the bars and the heat. Swing, let go at the top, throw again. Not every bar holds your weight.
You made it across. Your hands are shaking.
This is where they come from.
At the far end, on the altar, it waits. Like she said.
Light, far above. Take it home.
Barely wider than your shoulders. You go in on your hands and knees.
It narrows. Breathe out and push.
You hear the others breathing. Or something is.
It ends. Someone got this far and stopped. Back out, feet first.
A pocket of bones. No way on. The hole you dropped through is above you.
